Every entry retains: source_id, source_key_type (matching ingestion/venue-onboarding/candidates.mjs's CANDIDATE_KEY_TYPES), source_key (the exact, normalised key — see candidates.mjs's deriveCandidateKey), venue_id, evidence, and created/retrieved provenance. Adding a new venue mapping is a DATA change here, never a code change in ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs. Existing historical hardcoded mappings already in ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs (AgendaLX Capitólio/Graça/BOTA, Hot Clube Capitólio, the Capitólio venue-page location_text table, BOTA/Odivelas/fixed-venue-source tables) are deliberately left untouched by this package — they are not migrated here, per this task's explicit 'unnecessary regression risk' guidance. This file starts empty; every entry present after a real run was appended by `npm run onboard:venues` (ingestion/venue-onboarding/run.mjs), never hand-authored, from the bounded, evidence-gated decisions in venues/candidate-research.json.
